text: 法国财政监督机构警告称，政府2027年预算草案所依据的经济假设“乐观”，这给削减高企财政赤字的计划带来风险。法国政府周四早些时候向内阁提交了一项财政法案，预计经济增速将从2026年的0.5%加快至1%，并计划将财政赤字占国内生产总值(GDP)的比例从5.4%降至5%。负责监督公共财政的独立机构法国公共财政高级委员会(HCFP)表示，这些预测假设私人投资将显著回升，但法国主权借贷成本飙升可能会传导至企业和家庭的融资环境。
text_en: France's fiscal watchdog warned that the economic assumptions underlying the government's 2027 budget draft are "optimistic," posing risks to the plan to reduce the high fiscal deficit. The French government earlier on Thursday submitted a finance bill to the cabinet, forecasting economic growth to accelerate from 0.5% in 2026 to 1%, and planning to reduce the fiscal deficit as a share of gross domestic product (GDP) from 5.4% to 5%. The High Council of Public Finance (HCFP), an independent body responsible for monitoring public finances, said these forecasts assume a significant rebound in private investment, but the surge in France's sovereign borrowing costs may feed through to the financing environment for businesses and households.
